resolution: bootstrap.paths derives platform-native runtime home and use environment; there is no silent fallback when LOCALAPPDATA/XDG home is invalid.

roles.development: canonical writable checkout, never mutate active use path
roles.use: separate user-scoped managed launcher and manifest; no game Mods install or daemon
roles.worktrees: agent isolation only, not second mutable canonical clone

installation: bootstrap.py install clones only if canonical checkout absent and writes only manifest-owned launcher+manifest
uninstallation: bootstrap.py uninstall removes only verified launcher+manifest; removes exact checkout only if this installer created it and it has no tracked modifications, untracked or ignored data
